remarks: Discover the perfect blend of seclusion and natural beauty with these two buildable parcels totaling 49.8 acres, offering a rare opportunity for your dream home, private retreat, or recreational haven. Featuring a mix of level and gently rolling topography, this versatile land invites countless possibilities for development or enjoyment. The property boasts partially wooded acreage, providing both privacy and open space for building, farming or simply soaking in the surrounding tranquility. There are approximately 40 acres timber that are of nice quality and have always been properly managed. Outdoor enthusiasts will be captivated by the pristine trout stream, which offers miles of trails ideal for hiking, fishing, horseback riding, or ATV adventures. One of the highlights of this exceptional property is the beautiful, meandering Bemus Creek that flows gracefully through the landscape, creating a peaceful, picturesque setting that must be seen to be appreciated. There is a 200 ft driveway that could be paved if someone were inclined to do so. There is an electrical transformer along the driveway that would allow for easy installation of electricity. Whether you're looking to build your dream home, start a small farm, or enjoy a weekend escape immersed in nature, this property delivers it all-peace, privacy, and potential. Please make an appointment to see this property. The seller does not want unaccompanied buyers on the property.
facts: Electricity Available, Sewer Not Available, Water Not Available
